infoCards.title: Digital Publishing
infoCards.description: Advanced digital publishing and distribution system.

faqData.question: How does the system manage content workflow?
faqData.answer: Our system provides comprehensive content management with manuscript tracking, editorial workflow automation, version control and collaborative tools for authors, editors, and reviewers.

faqData.question: What digital publishing features are included?
faqData.answer: The system includes advanced digital publishing capabilities with multi-format output (print, ebook, web), automated formatting, digital rights management and distribution channel integration.

faqData.question: Can it handle rights and royalty management?
faqData.answer: Yes, our solution manages rights contracts, royalty calculations, payment tracking, and reporting with automated statements generation and rights expiration monitoring.
